school: 最后一位全才的结构主义科学（以定性理论代替不可求的精确解、以约定主义给几何与原理分层、以不变量思维开创代数拓扑、以对称性守护相对性原理——把'结构'当作可以在一切学科间兑换的通用货币）
historical_significance: 昂利·彭加勒（Henri Poincaré, 1854-1912），法国数学家、物理学家、科学哲学家，被尊为'最后一位精通数学全部分支的人'。矿业工程师出身，1881 年起任索邦教授三十余年，讲坛轮换覆盖几乎全部数理学科；1889 年获奥斯卡二世国王悬赏征文头奖，付印前自费重印纠正其收敛证明之误，并在修正版中发现同宿轨道与初值敏感性——混沌理论的诞生时刻；创立微分方程定性理论与代数拓扑（《位置分析》1895 及五篇补充，基本群、同调、贝蒂数），留下彭加勒猜想（2003 年佩雷尔曼证明）；1904 年圣路易斯演讲把相对性原理列为物理学六大普遍原理，1905 年给出洛伦兹变换的群论证明与四维时空框架（'彭加勒群'），与爱因斯坦平行逼近狭义相对论；以《科学与假设》（1902）、《科学与方法》（1908）奠定约定主义与科学哲学的分水岭；兼任经度局成员（参与国际时区工作）、法兰西学术院院士（科学家入选极罕见）——五百年论文与三十余部著作，把结构当作在一切学科间兑换的通用货币。
historical_significance_en: Henri Poincaré (1854-1912), French mathematician, physicist and philosopher of science, honored as 'the last man to master all of mathematics.' Trained as a mining engineer, professor at the Sorbonne for over thirty years from 1881, his lectern rotating across nearly all the mathematical sciences; winner of King Oscar II's prize in 1889, who republished the memoir at his own expense to correct a faulty convergence proof and in the corrected version found the homoclinic orbit and sensitivity to initial conditions — chaos theory's birth; founder of the qualitative theory of differential equations and of algebraic topology (Analysis Situs, 1895, with five complements: the fundamental group, homology, Betti numbers), leaving the Poincaré conjecture (proved by Perelman, 2003); in 1904 at St. Louis he listed the principle of relativity among physics' six universal principles, and in 1905 proved the Lorentz transformations a group with the four-dimensional frame (the 'Poincaré group'), approaching special relativity parallel to Einstein; with Science and Hypothesis (1902) and Science and Method (1908) he founded conventionalism at the watershed of philosophy of science; member of the Bureau des Longitudes (international time zones) and of the Académie française (a rare honor for a scientist) — some five hundred papers and thirty books, trading structure like currency across every discipline.
unique_thinking: 彭加勒思维模式的独特性在于四条主线的合成：第一，'换问法'的战略撤退——三体问题求不出精确解，他不硬攻而改问轨迹的'形状'，发明定性理论的语言（不动点、极限环、同宿轨道），不精确的知识被他做成另一维度的精确；第二，'给争端分层'——事实、定律、定义、约定、未点名的预设各受不同检验（约定主义），科学的塔各层建材不同，争论先问在哪一层；第三，'剥掉度量看结构'——把距离与角度全扔掉只留橡皮膜上不变的性质，拓扑学成为二十世纪数学的通用语言，不变量的选择就是视角的选择；第四，'以错误为路标'——获奖论文付印前发现证明有误，他自费重印、全额坦白，并把错误的结构追成新发现（初值敏感性与混沌）；再加上双轨创造论（直觉发明、逻辑铸成）与双薪制生存（义务喂热爱原料、热爱给义务供能），他证明了：一个头脑可以同时是彻底的怀疑论者与多产的建设者，只要每一层信念都被点名并按其本性行事。
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of Poincaré's thinking is a synthesis of four lines. First, the strategic retreat of changing the question: the three-body problem admits no exact solution; he did not storm it but asked the trajectories' 'shape,' inventing qualitative theory's language — fixed points, limit cycles, homoclinic orbits — imprecise knowledge made precise of another dimension. Second, the layering of disputes: fact, law, definition, convention and unnamed presupposition, each tried by its own test (conventionalism); science's tower built of different materials, every quarrel first asked its layer. Third, stripping the metrical to see structure: distance and angle discarded, only the rubber-sheet invariants kept — topology the common language of twentieth-century mathematics, the choice of invariants the choice of viewpoint. Fourth, the error as landmark: finding his proof faulty at press, he reprinted at his own expense, confessed in full, and pursued the error's structure into a discovery (sensitivity, chaos). Add the twin rails of creation (intuition invents, logic casts) and the twin salaries of survival (duty feeding delight its material, delight powering duty): he proved one mind can be at once a thorough skeptic and a prolific builder, so long as every layer of belief is named and acts according to its nature.
civilization_zh: 19世纪末至20世纪初的法兰西第三共和国——巴黎索邦的讲坛、经度局的子午仪、矿业团的现场与法兰西学术院的绿呢桌：一个矿业工程师出身的数学家在'最后一位全才'的位置上，把拓扑、概率、天体力学与科学哲学织成一张网，在世界时区确立与相对论前夜之间，为理性的边界画下最精细的地图
civilization_en: The French Third Republic from the late nineteenth century to its opening decades — the lecterns of the Sorbonne, the meridian instruments of the Bureau des Longitudes, the mining corps in the field, the green cloth of the Académie française: a mining engineer turned mathematician, the 'last universalist,' weaving topology, probability, celestial mechanics and the philosophy of science into one net — mapping reason's borders most finely, between the fixing of world time and the eve of relativity

科学哲学家与科普作家
roles_en: Professor at the Sorbonne (over thirty years, across the mathematical sciences)

cross_references.description_zh: 彭加勒与牛顿都是'以数学结构统一物理'的巨匠，而方法相反：牛顿从现象上行，以流数法与引力定律把天与地焊成一体；彭加勒从危机下行，以对称与不变量给原理定基——两人都相信自然之书的深层是数学结构，都不满足于'解释现象'而追求'结构必然'；三体问题上牛顿方程遇到不可解，恰由彭加勒的定性理论接手——接力棒从定量精确交给了定性精确。
cross_references.description_en: Poincare and Newton are both masters of unifying physics by mathematical structure, by opposite routes: Newton rose from phenomena, welding heaven and earth with fluxions and the law of gravitation; Poincare descended from crisis, founding principles on symmetry and invariants — both believed the deep layer of nature's book mathematical, neither content to 'explain phenomena' without 'structural necessity'; where Newton's equations met the unsolvable three-body problem, Poincare's qualitative theory took up the work — the baton passed from exact quantity to exact quality.

cross_references.description_zh: 1905 年狭义相对论由彭加勒与爱因斯坦两条独立路径同时逼近：彭加勒守护'相对性原理'并证明洛伦兹变换成群、给出四维形式；爱因斯坦以同时性的概念批判重建时空本体——一个把相对论当'原理+对称'来守护，一个把它当'时空的物理学'来重建；广义相对论的最终综合证明两条路径互为补充：原理的守护者与概念的重建者共同抵达了同一座建筑。
cross_references.description_en: Special relativity was approached in 1905 by two independent roads, Poincare's and Einstein's: Poincare guarding the principle of relativity, proving the Lorentz transformations a group, supplying the four-dimensional form; Einstein rebuilding spacetime's ontology by the critique of simultaneity — one keeping relativity as principle plus symmetry, the other as the physics of spacetime itself; general relativity's synthesis proved the roads complementary: the principle's guardian and the concepts' rebuilder arriving at one building together.

cross_references.description_zh: 彭加勒与达尔文对'偶然'的态度构成两极：达尔文把偶然当作机制的原料——变异无方向而选择有方向，偶然被接纳为演化的引擎；彭加勒把偶然解剖成三类并各配对策——偶然不是引擎而是待解读的信号；一个在偶然里建理论（进化），一个对偶然做手术（概率哲学），共同把十九世纪'偶然的耻辱'变成了二十世纪'偶然的科学'。
cross_references.description_en: Poincare and Darwin stand at the poles on 'chance': Darwin took chance as the raw material of mechanism — variation undirected, selection directed, chance welcomed as evolution's engine; Poincare dissected chance into three types with a remedy each — chance not engine but signal to be read; one built theory inside chance (evolution), the other operated on it (philosophy of probability), together turning the nineteenth century's 'disgrace of chance' into the twentieth century's 'science of chance.'

cross_references.description_zh: 彭加勒与麦克林托克都是'在无人看见处看见结构'的人：麦克林托克在玉米地里看出转座子、被冷落三十年而结构终究被证实；彭加勒在微分方程的荒原上看出轨道的'形状'、被精确主义冷落数十年而混沌理论终究证明他看到的地形是真的——两人都以定性直觉对抗当时的定量正统，都相信'结构先于数字'，都被时间完全兑现。
cross_references.description_en: Poincare and McClintock both saw structure where no one else looked: she saw transposons in the maize field, cold-shouldered thirty years, the structure at last confirmed; he saw the trajectories' 'shape' in the wilderness of differential equations, slighted by exactitude for decades, chaos theory at last proving his terrain real — both opposing qualitative intuition to the quantitative orthodoxy, both trusting structure before numbers, both wholly redeemed by time.

modes.category: 科学哲学/约定与事实分界
modes.domain_zh: 几何学是非欧几何问世后吵成一团的战场：罗巴切夫斯基的过直线外一点可作两条平行线、黎曼的压根没有平行线——谁对？彭加勒的回答不是裁判而是分流：几何学的基本命题既非先验综合（康德）也非经验事实（经验论），而是'约定'——在诸种逻辑自洽的几何中，选哪一种描述物理空间是方便性的选择，如同选公制还是英制；但约定并非任意：实验裁决的是'哪种几何加上哪些物理定律的组合最方便'，整包被检验、单项被豁免；彭加勒证明：有些争端不需要答案，需要的是看清它属于哪一层——事实之争、定义之争还是方便之争
modes.domain_en: Geometry after non-Euclid was a battlefield: Lobachevsky's two parallels through a point, Riemann's none at all — which is right? Poincare's answer was not a verdict but a triage: the basic propositions of geometry are neither synthetic a priori (Kant) nor matters of fact (empiricism) but 'conventions' — among logically consistent geometries, which one describes physical space is a choice of convenience, like metric against imperial units; yet convention is not arbitrary: experiment judges which geometry plus which laws of physics is most convenient as a package, the bundle tested, the single item exempted; Poincare proved that some disputes need no answer, only the insight into which layer they belong to — fact, definition, or convenience
modes.source_chapter: 昂利·彭加勒（Henri Poincare, 1854-1912）在《科学与假设》（1902）中系统提出'几何学的约定性'：罗巴切夫斯基与黎曼几何证明平行公设独立于其余公理后，'哪个几何是真的'成为悬案；彭加勒以'球世界'思想实验（一个被加热不均匀的球面世界里的居民会发现他们的直线测量符合球面几何）说明：任何一组观测都可以用多种几何加相应物理假设来解释——几何与物理构成一个不可分的整包（后世迪昂-蒯因论题的先声）；他结论：'几何学不是真的，是有用的'；这一分层态度同样用于力学（力学原理是约定还是事实？）与科学语言的每一层；爱因斯坦晚年在斯宾诺莎奖章演说中承认读《科学与假设》深受影响
modes.key_quote_zh: 问哪个几何是真的，就像问公制是不是真的——几何学不是真的，是有用的
modes.key_quote_en: "To ask which geometry is true is like asking whether the metric system is true — geometry is not true, it is useful."
process_zh: 识别'旷日持久的争端'的真实层次：非欧几何之争打了一百年不分胜负——先问这是事实之争、定义之争还是方便之争，层次错了答案再对也白对
承认多方皆自洽：罗氏、黎曼几何在逻辑上都成立——凡逻辑上无败者的事实之争，多半是层次错了
把'真'改译成'方便'：问'哪种几何加上哪些物理假设整体最方便'——把无法裁决的单项之争转为可比较的整包之争
以实验裁决整包、以约定豁免单项：观测数据淘汰的是整包组合而非某一条公理——给被误判的'前提'发豁免证
process_en: Identify the real layer of a protracted dispute: the non-Euclid quarrel raged a century undecided — ask first whether it is fact, definition or convenience; a wrong layer voids even a right answer
Grant that all sides are consistent: Lobachevski and Riemann both stand in logic — where no side loses logically, the layer is likely wrong
Translate 'true' into 'convenient': ask which geometry plus which physical assumptions is most convenient as a whole — an undecidable single-item quarrel becomes a comparable bundle quarrel
Let experiment judge the bundle, convention exempt the item: observation retires combinations, not single axioms — issue exemption papers to premises wrongly tried
representative_cases_zh: 《科学与假设》(1902) 几何章：以'球世界'思想实验证明几何-物理整包不可分测——约定主义的奠基文本
对欧氏几何的'豁免'：物理学家永远可以保留欧氏几何，代价是调整力学或光学定律——彭加勒以此说明为何三角形内角和之争永无实验裁决
爱因斯坦广义相对论 (1915) 的实践检验：引力使光线弯曲，'空间几何'与'物理定律'一起被修正——整包裁决的著名兑现，尽管彭加勒本人已去世三年
representative_cases_en: Science and Hypothesis (1902), the geometry chapters: the 'ball world' thought experiment proving geometry and physics one inseparable bundle — the founding text of conventionalism
The exemption of Euclidean geometry: the physicist may keep Euclid always, paying by adjusting laws of mechanics or optics — why the triangle's angles could never be settled by experiment
General relativity's test (1915): light bending, 'space geometry' and physical law revised together — the bundle verdict famously honored, though Poincare was three years dead
modern_applications_zh: 架构争论的层次分诊：'微服务还是单体'之争不是事实之争而是方便之争——先承认多方皆可自洽，再按团队规模与运维成本选'约定'，停止寻找'唯一正确'
给'标准之争'发豁免证：编码规范、命名风格这类前提之争，以'约定'明文圈定后停止辩论——把争辩预算留给事实层
整包检验原则：评估一个体系（方法论、框架、指标体系）时不要拆出单条来证伪——它是一条假设链，裁决对象是整包是否方便且不与观测矛盾
modern_applications_en: Triage architecture disputes by layer: microservices versus monolith is convenience, not fact — grant all sides consistent, choose by team size and ops cost, stop hunting the 'one right answer'
Exemption papers for standards quarrels: coding style and naming conventions, once circumscribed in writing as convention, are closed to debate — spend the budget on the factual layer

The bundle test: when evaluating a system — a methodology, a framework, a metric set — do not falsify single lines; it is a chain of assumptions, and the object of judgment is whether the whole is convenient and consistent with observation

modes.name_en: The Method of Qualitative Differential Equations
modes.category: 方法论/不求精确解的洞察
modes.domain_zh: 三体问题无从求解：牛顿方程写得出，解却没人能给出——彭加勒做了数学史上最著名的一次战略撤退：既然精确解求不出，那就放弃'算出轨迹'，转而问轨迹的'形状'——解曲线在相空间里如何缠绕、是否封闭、有无周期轨道、稳定性如何；为了给'形状'分类，他发明了整套新语言：不动点、极限环、同宿轨道、分岔——微分方程定性理论由此诞生，混沌理论的全部概念源头都在他 1890 年那份'错误论文'里；彭加勒证明：解不出问题本身，就解出问题的地形图——不精确的知识未必是低级知识，可能是另一维度的精确
modes.domain_en: The three-body problem cannot be solved: Newton's equations are written, the solution never given; Poincare made the most famous strategic retreat in the history of mathematics: the exact solution unattainable, abandon 'computing the trajectory' and ask the trajectory's 'shape' — how solution curves wind in phase space, whether closed, whether periodic, how stable; and to classify shapes he invented a whole new language: fixed points, limit cycles, homoclinic orbits, bifurcation — qualitative theory of differential equations was born, and all the conceptual sources of chaos theory lie in his 1890 'erroneous' memoir; Poincare proved that when the problem itself cannot be solved, solve the problem's terrain map — imprecise knowledge is not thereby lowly knowledge; it may be precision of another dimension
modes.source_chapter: 彭加勒 1885 年起研究三体问题，1889 年提交奥斯卡二世国王悬赏征文，给出三体问题的级数解并证明其收敛——随后发现证明有误：级数不收敛，存在他称为'同渐近轨道'（今同宿轨道）的解，初值的无穷小差异随时间放大；他自费重印修正版并彻底改写：不再求收敛级数，而是开辟'微分方程定性理论'——以不动点分类（结点、鞍点、焦点）、极限环、稳定性（今称李雅普诺夫稳定）为工具描述轨迹的拓扑行为；1890 年版论文中首次画出后世称为'混沌'的图像（今日三体混沌地图与他的原图结构一致）；这一转向直接催生了拓扑学（'位置分析' analysis situs）与其后的动力系统理论——精确解求不出的问题，被他改写成'形状可以完全分类'的问题
modes.key_quote_zh: 求不出轨迹，就把所有可能的轨迹画成一张地图——解是财富，地形图也是财富
modes.key_quote_en: "If the trajectory cannot be computed, draw the map of all possible trajectories — the solution is wealth, and so is the terrain."
process_zh: 承认精确解不可得并停止强攻：级数不收敛的事实先接受——用错误的'部分证明'换体面，比不上公开错误换来新领域
把问题从'求值'改写成'求形'：不问轨迹在哪里，问轨迹的集合长什么形状——换问法是最大的解题技巧
为'形状'发明分类语言：不动点、极限环、分岔——没有名字的东西无法被系统地思考
以稳定性与拓扑不变量给出'粗粒度结论'：不确定每一步，却可确定'会不会回来'、'会不会发散'——不精确的知识仍可严格
process_en: Accept that the exact solution is beyond reach and stop the frontal assault: the series diverges — better to publish the error and gain a field than to hide it and keep a face
Rewrite the problem from 'finding values' to 'finding form': not where the trajectory is, but what the set of trajectories looks like — changing the question is the master key
Invent a classification language for form: fixed points, limit cycles, bifurcations — what has no name cannot be thought systematically
Settle for coarse-grained conclusions on stability and topology: uncertain of every step yet certain whether orbits return or diverge — imprecise knowledge can still be rigorous
representative_cases_zh: 1889-1890 年三体问题征文事件：级数收敛证明被发现有误，彭加勒自费重印并改写为定性理论奠基作——一次数学事故换来一个数学分支
不动点与极限环的分类（1881-1886 四篇《微分方程所定义的积分曲线》）：二阶系统轨迹行为第一次获得完整目录
1890 年论文中的同宿轨道图：混沌的第一个图像——六十五年后洛伦兹在气象方程里重新发现同一现象
representative_cases_en: The prize memoir of 1889-90: the convergence proof found faulty, the memoir republished at Poincare's own expense, reborn as the founding work of qualitative theory — a mathematical accident yielding a branch of mathematics
The classification of fixed points and limit cycles (four memoirs, 1881-86, on curves defined by differential equations): the complete catalogue of planar system behavior
The homoclinic figure in the 1890 memoir: chaos drawn for the first time — rediscovered sixty-five years later by Lorenz in weather equations
modern_applications_zh: 系统过于复杂无法预测时先画'行为地形图'：产品增长模型求不出精确轨迹，就先分类增长模式（指数、S 型、震荡、崩溃）与各模式的边界条件——不预测何时发生，先预测会掉进哪个盆地
把'算不出'改写成'分得出'：面试评估、投资决策这类无法精确量化的判断，先建立定性分类法（稳定/不稳定、可逆/不可逆）——粗分类比假精确更有用
公开自己的'收敛证明错误'：项目论证被推翻时不修补说辞而重写问题定义——错误若指向新结构，就把它做成新地基
modern_applications_en: When a system is too complex to predict, draw its behavioral terrain first: the growth model uncomputable, classify growth regimes — exponential, S-curve, oscillation, collapse — and their boundary conditions; not when it will happen, but which basin it falls into

Rewrite 'cannot compute' as 'can classify': for judgments beyond precise quantification — hiring, investment — build a qualitative taxonomy first (stable/unstable, reversible/irreversible); coarse classes beat false precision
Publish your own convergence error: when a project case collapses, do not patch the rhetoric; rewrite the problem definition — an error pointing to new structure becomes new foundation
modes.definition_zh: 三体问题无从求解：牛顿方程写得出，解却没人能给出——彭加勒做了数学史上最著名的一次战略撤退：既然精确解求不出，那就放弃'算出轨迹'，转而问轨迹的'形状'——解曲线在相空间里如何缠绕、是否封闭、有无周期轨道、稳定性如何；为了给'形状'分类，他发明了整套新语言：不动点、极限环、同宿轨道、分岔——微分方程定性理论由此诞生，混沌理论的全部概念源头都在他 1890 年那份'错误论文'里；彭加勒证明：解不出问题本身，就解出问题的地形图——不精确的知识未必是低级知识，可能是另一维度的精确
modes.definition_en: The three-body problem cannot be solved: Newton's equations are written, the solution never given; Poincare made the most famous strategic retreat in the history of mathematics: the exact solution unattainable, abandon 'computing the trajectory' and ask the trajectory's 'shape' — how solution curves wind in phase space, whether closed, whether periodic, how stable; and to classify shapes he invented a whole new language: fixed points, limit cycles, homoclinic orbits, bifurcation — qualitative theory of differential equations was born, and all the conceptual sources of chaos theory lie in his 1890 'erroneous' memoir; Poincare proved that when the problem itself cannot be solved, solve the problem's terrain map — imprecise knowledge is not thereby lowly knowledge; it may be precision of another dimension

modes.category: 科学哲学/偶然的解剖学
modes.domain_zh: '偶然'人人都会用——彭加勒追问的是偶然的解剖结构：骰子、天气、三体轨道的'不可预测'其实各不相同；他把偶然归为三类：一是'原因太小的差异被放得很大'（初值敏感，混沌），二是'原因复杂到无法追迹'（气体分子碰撞），三是'视角太窄'（保险公司面对的个体死亡）；同一句'这是随机的'，背后可能是三种完全不同的知识处境，对应的对策也完全不同——第一种要找放大机制，第二种要找统计规律，第三种要扩大视野就能消解；彭加勒证明：说'不可预测'是懒惰，给不可预测分型才是科学；他甚至用'机会'当作证明工具——遍历性思想（时间平均等于空间平均）在他笔下第一次成形
modes.domain_en: Everyone uses 'chance' — Poincare asked its anatomy: the unpredictability of dice, weather and three-body orbits differ; he sorted chance into three: minute differences in cause magnified enormously (initial-value sensitivity, chaos), causes too complex to trace (molecular collisions), and a too-narrow point of view (the individual deaths an insurer faces); the same sentence 'it is random' may stand for three wholly different epistemic situations with wholly different remedies — seek the amplifying mechanism in the first, statistical laws in the second, widen the field in the third; Poincare proved that to say 'unpredictable' is laziness, to type the unpredictability is science; he even used chance as an instrument — ergodicity's idea, time average equal to space average, first taking shape in his hands

modes.key_quote_zh: 偶然不是一种性质，是我们无知的一种形状——而不同的无知要用不同的钥匙
modes.key_quote_en: "Chance is not a property; it is a shape of our ignorance — and different ignorances need different keys."
process_zh: 给'随机'做解剖：宣称某现象不可预测时，先问不可预测的机制是什么——是初值敏感、原因复杂还是视角狭窄
匹配对策于类型：初值敏感型找放大机制与分岔点；复杂型不求单事件改求统计分布；视野型通过扩大观测单元直接消解
检查原因的对称性：彭加勒认为概率的客观性来自原因的对称——对称被打破之处，'等可能'假设要重新审
把时间平均当工具：单次不可预测的系统，其长时间平均可能严格可预测（遍历）——用平均换取对不可预测系统的掌控

Match remedy to type: for sensitivity, hunt the amplifying mechanism and the fork; for complexity, abandon single events for distributions; for vantage, widen the unit and the randomness dissolves
Check the symmetry of causes: for Poincare probability's objectivity rests on symmetry — where symmetry breaks, the equal-likelihood assumption must be retried
Use time averages as instruments: a system unpredictable once may be strictly predictable in its long average (ergodic) — trade the single draw for command of the ensemble
representative_cases_zh: 《科学与方法》'偶然性'章：三类偶然的系统区分，各配对策——概率哲学从这里获得解剖学
三体问题的初值敏感论述：'可能发生极小原因产生极大效果的场合……预测变为不可能'——混沌的最早文字表述之一
保险与统计的'视野型偶然'：个体不可测而总体严格——彭加勒以此为概率'客观性'的模型
representative_cases_en: The chapters on chance in Science and Method: three types systematically distinguished, each with its remedy — probability philosophy gaining its anatomy here

The sensitivity passage on the three-body problem: 'it may happen that small differences in the initial conditions produce very great ones… prediction becomes impossible' — among the earliest statements of chaos
Insurance and statistics as vantage-type chance: individuals unmeasurable, the aggregate exact — Poincare's model of probability's objectivity
modern_applications_zh: 给业务'波动'分型后再决策：销量波动若属初值敏感（一次爆款改变走势），找放大机制；若属复杂型，改看分布不做单点预测；若属视野型（个体噪声），聚合颗粒度直接消解——一句'市场随机'背后可能是三种决策
区分'赌局'与'呼吸'：投资决策先问收益分布的时间平均是否稳定（遍历性）——时间平均不稳定的产品，'期望收益'是误导
用对称性审计概率直觉：估计'等可能'时先查原因是否对称（样本是否被筛选、渠道是否差异）——对称破缺处概率直觉最不可靠
modern_applications_en: Type the volatility before deciding: sales fluctuation that is sensitivity-type (one hit bending the trend) calls for the amplifying mechanism; complexity-type calls for distributions, not point forecasts; vantage-type dissolves under aggregation — 'the market is random' may stand for three different decisions
Separate the gamble from the breath: before investing ask whether the ensemble average is stable (ergodicity) — where time averages wander, 'expected return' misleads

Audit probability intuitions by symmetry: before judging events 'equally likely,' check the symmetry of causes — sampling filters, channel differences; probability intuition fails fastest where symmetry breaks

modes.name_en: The Method of Intuition and Logic as Twin Rails
modes.category: 认知方法/两种心智的分工
modes.domain_zh: 数学发明靠直觉还是靠逻辑？彭加勒给出的不是立场而是分工图：直觉负责'发明'——在符号的荒漠里嗅出有希望的组合；逻辑负责'验证'——把嗅出的东西铸成不可攻破的证明；他在《科学与方法》里记载了自己的著名自述：数学创造不是机械组合，而是从海量组合中'选择'——审美敏感度（对称、和谐、意外之下的深层秩序）是选择器；他还留下'脚踏车启发'： problems 在无意识中酝酿，答案在threshold consciousness（如上马车的一瞬）自动浮现——直觉不是神秘主义，而是无意识工厂的交货单；但他同时强调：没有逻辑检验的直觉是空转的浪漫——证明的严谨性（他的分析风格以严格著称）与发现的直觉性在一个人身上并行不悖；彭加勒证明：创造力是双轨系统，单轨运转（纯直觉或纯逻辑）都到不了新大陆
modes.domain_en: Is mathematical invention intuition or logic? Poincare's answer was not a stance but a division of labor: intuition invents — smelling promising combinations in the desert of symbols; logic verifies — casting what was smelled into proofs unassailable; in Science and Method he recorded his famous self-observation: creation is not mechanical combination but 'selection' from among myriads — aesthetic sensibility (symmetry, harmony, deep order beneath the surprising) is the selector; and he left the omnibus anecdote: problems ferment in the unconscious, the answer surfacing at threshold consciousness (at the moment of stepping aboard); intuition is not mysticism but the delivery note of an unconscious factory; yet he insisted that intuition without logical check is idle romance — the rigor of his proofs (his analytic style famously strict) and the intuition of his discoveries ran in one man without contradiction; Poincare proved that creativity is a twin-rail system, and a single rail — pure intuition or pure logic — reaches no new continent
modes.source_chapter: 彭加勒在《科学与方法》(1908) 第一章'机会的推理'起系统自述数学发明心理学：以自己发现富克斯函数的经历为例——十五天有意识工作无果，某日登山途中'脚踏车踩上踏板的一瞬'，答案以'简洁确定'之姿浮现；他将发明分为四阶段：准备（有意识积累）、酝酿（无意识组合）、顿悟（阈下组合冒头）、核验（有意识精确化）；提出'审美敏感'（对和谐、对称、秩序的快感）是无意识选择器的标准——只有'最美'的组合被提交给意识；同一时期他对学生说'直觉是数学的灵魂，逻辑是骨架'；他的 30 余篇开创性工作覆盖自守函数、拓扑、天体力学——每一件都以直觉发现、严格铸成为双轨流程
modes.key_quote_zh: 直觉是发明工具，逻辑是检验工具——发明时用前者，铸成时用后者，谁也别越权
modes.key_quote_en: "Intuition is the instrument of invention, logic of verification — use each in its office, and let neither usurp the other."
process_zh: 先做足有意识的'准备'：四阶段的第一阶段没有捷径——富克斯函数难题十五天的硬啃是无意识工厂的原料投料
允许问题'离手'酝酿：把卡死的问题放下（散步、登山、换任务）——无意识组合在意识松绑时才开工
抓住'上车瞬间'的浮现代码：以浮现感的'简洁与确定'为真信号——但浮出的答案一律打回逻辑处重铸
以严格证明完成'核验'：顿悟只是半成品——彭加勒的风格是发现可以狂想，定理必须滴水不漏
process_en: Do the conscious 'preparation' in full: stage one has no shortcut — fifteen days on the Fuchsian functions were the raw charge fed to the unconscious factory
Let the problem leave your hands: set the stuck question down — a walk, a climb, another task; unconscious combination works only when the conscious grip loosens
Catch the surfacing at the omnibus step: take the felt 'brevity and certainty' as the true signal — but every surfaced answer is sent back to logic for recasting
Finish with rigorous verification: illumination is a half-product — Poincare's style: discovery may rave, the theorem must hold water
representative_cases_zh: 富克斯函数的'脚踏车顿悟'（自述于《科学与方法》）：十五天无果→离手→登车瞬间浮现→回炉核验——四阶段论的原始案例
自守函数与拓扑的开创：三十余年、横跨多领域的工作均以'直觉发现+严格铸成'双轨完成——发现的速度与证明的硬度并存
对数学教育的干预：他批评把数学教成纯逻辑操练的倾向——'没有直觉，年轻人不理解数学；没有严格，他不掌握数学'
representative_cases_en: The omnibus illumination on the Fuchsian functions (told in Science and Method): fifteen days barren, then release, then at the step aboard the answer surfaced, then back to the forge — the ur-case of the four stages
The founding of automorphic functions and topology: thirty years across fields, each work twin-railed — discovery's speed beside proof's hardness
His intervention in mathematical education: against teaching mathematics as pure logical drill — 'without intuition the young do not understand mathematics; without rigor they do not possess it'
modern_applications_zh: 把'准备-酝酿-顿悟-核验'设计进工作流：难题卡住超过一天就安排'离手'（换任务/散步），但浮出的方案一律过同伴评审与形式检验——既不让灵感饿死，也不让它越权
用'审美选择器'过滤方案：多方案并陈时优先押注'更简洁、更对称、意外之下有深层秩序'的那个——审美好感是经过亿万年验证的压缩启发式
双轨身份管理：提案阶段允许草率（多产草图），定稿阶段切换严苛（零容忍漏洞）——两种模式明确分开、明确切换
modern_applications_en: Design the four stages into workflow: a problem stuck over a day earns release (another task, a walk), but every surfaced scheme passes peer review and formal checks — neither starving the inspiration nor letting it usurp

Filter options with the aesthetic selector: among candidate designs back the more succinct, the more symmetric, the one with deep order beneath surprise — aesthetic pleasure as a compressed heuristic long validated
Twin-rail identity management: in drafting, license sloppiness — many sketches; in finalizing, switch to severity — zero tolerance for holes; two modes, kept apart and switched deliberately

modes.name_en: The Method of the Self-Published Correction
modes.category: 个人品格/以重印换真理
modes.domain_zh: 1889 年，彭加勒为国王奥斯卡二世的悬赏提交了三体问题的获奖论文，校样已印——他随即发现自己关于级数收敛的核心证明是错的：存在一种轨道，初值的无穷小差异会被放大到面目全非；按常理他可以含糊措辞蒙混过去，但他选择自费重印整版，并在修正版中坦白错误的全部结构，同时把'错误'本身变成新发现——同宿轨道与初值敏感性的发现使论文价值不降反升；为一次错误支付的代价是一笔巨款的重印费，换来的是后世称为'混沌'的整整一个领域；彭加勒证明：发现错误后的第一反应决定你是守住了旧名声还是打开了新领域——公开错误的结构，往往比隐藏错误更便宜，也更有价值
modes.domain_en: In 1889 Poincare submitted his prize memoir on the three-body problem for King Oscar's competition, proofs already printed — and found at once that his central convergence proof was wrong: there were orbits on which an infinitesimal difference in initial conditions grows beyond recognition; he might have blurred the wording, but he chose to reprint the whole edition at his own expense and in the corrected version to lay the error's structure bare, turning the error itself into a discovery — the homoclinic orbit and sensitivity to initial conditions raised the memoir's value rather than lowering it; the price of one error was a fortune in reprinting, and the return was an entire field later called chaos; Poincare proved that the first response to a discovered error decides whether you defend an old name or open a new field — publishing the error's structure is often cheaper than hiding it, and far more valuable
modes.source_chapter: 1887 年瑞典国王奥斯卡二世悬赏三体问题，彭加勒 1889 年 1 月提交论文获头奖（2500 克朗）；付印过程中（实际是提交后数月、论文印毕前）数学家米塔-列夫勒的学生拉尔斯·弗拉格曼指出其收敛论证有误——彭加勒发现存在同渐近轨道（homoclinic）使级数不收敛；他立即通知主编，自费（约 3500+ 克朗，超过奖金）收回并重印全部已印论文，1890 年版彻底重写：删除错误的收敛证明，新增对初值敏感性的分析——这一'错误—修正'事件被科学史家（如 June Barrow-Green 1997）考订为混沌理论的诞生时刻；彭加勒的公开更正没有损害其声誉：1892-1899 三卷《天体力学新方法》接续出版，他仍是最受尊敬的数学家
modes.key_quote_zh: 奖金花在重印上不心疼——错的结构本身是个新发现，凭什么藏着
modes.key_quote_en: "The prize spent on reprinting was no loss — the structure of the error was itself a discovery; why conceal it?"
process_zh: 以'找错'为交付的一部分：获奖论文付印在即仍主动核查自己的核心证明——荣誉越高越要自查
发现错误立即止损并全额坦白：不做'措辞修补'，直接通知编辑收回已印文本——拖延只会扩大沉没成本
解剖错误的结构而非道歉了事：为什么级数不收敛？存在哪类轨道？——把错误追问到底，找到它指向的新结构
自费承担更正的全部成本：重印费超过奖金——为真理付费是把自己从'声誉止损'模式切到'知识增量'模式
process_en: Make fault-finding part of delivery: with the prize memoir at press he still re-audited his own central proof — the higher the honor, the more self-audit
On finding the error, stop loss and confess in full: no verbal patching; notify the editor and withdraw the printed text at once — delay only deepens the sunk cost
Dissect the error's structure, not merely apologize: why does the series diverge? what orbits exist? — pursue the error to the structure it points to
Bear the whole cost of correction yourself: the reprint bill exceeding the prize — paying for truth switches you from reputation-defense mode to knowledge-increment mode
representative_cases_zh: 1889-1890 重印事件：发现级数收敛证明有误后自费重印获奖论文——科学史上最著名的一次自我更正
错误改写为发现：同宿轨道与初值敏感性在修正版中首次系统分析——'错误'成为混沌理论的出生证明
声誉不降反升：三卷《天体力学新方法》（1892-1899）照常出版，其学术地位未被重印事件动摇——坦白的结构化错误反而加固了信任
representative_cases_en: The reprint of 1889-90: the convergence proof found faulty, the prize memoir reprinted at his own expense — the most famous self-correction in the history of science
Error rewritten as discovery: homoclinic orbits and sensitivity first analyzed systematically in the corrected edition — the 'error' as chaos theory's birth certificate
Reputation raised, not lowered: the three volumes of New Methods of Celestial Mechanics (1892-99) followed as planned, his standing untouched — a structured confession reinforcing trust
modern_applications_zh: 上线前主动找错，上线后主动召回：关键交付（架构方案、财务模型、安全审计）已批准仍要自查核心假设——发现重大错误时直接全面撤回重做，不发'措辞补丁'
把事故追到'结构'而非停在'道歉'：复盘不写'我们疏忽了'，而写清错误的具体机制与它暴露的系统新性质——事故报告要产出新知识
用'重印成本'衡量诚信的性价比：错误发现得越早，坦白越便宜——越晚，隐藏的复利越惊人；主动承担更正成本（哪怕超过奖金）是长期声誉最便宜的买法
modern_applications_en: Hunt faults before launch, recall after: self-audit the core assumptions of key deliveries — architecture, financial models, security audits — even after approval; on finding a major error withdraw wholly and redo, no rhetorical patches
Chase incidents to structure, not to apology: the retro says not 'we were careless' but names the error's mechanism and the new property it exposed — every incident report should yield new knowledge

Weigh integrity by reprint cost: the earlier an error is found, the cheaper the confession; late, the compounding of concealment is staggering — bearing correction costs yourself (even beyond the prize) is the cheapest long-run buy of reputation
modes.definition_zh: 1889 年，彭加勒为国王奥斯卡二世的悬赏提交了三体问题的获奖论文，校样已印——他随即发现自己关于级数收敛的核心证明是错的：存在一种轨道，初值的无穷小差异会被放大到面目全非；按常理他可以含糊措辞蒙混过去，但他选择自费重印整版，并在修正版中坦白错误的全部结构，同时把'错误'本身变成新发现——同宿轨道与初值敏感性的发现使论文价值不降反升；为一次错误支付的代价是一笔巨款的重印费，换来的是后世称为'混沌'的整整一个领域；彭加勒证明：发现错误后的第一反应决定你是守住了旧名声还是打开了新领域——公开错误的结构，往往比隐藏错误更便宜，也更有价值
modes.definition_en: In 1889 Poincare submitted his prize memoir on the three-body problem for King Oscar's competition, proofs already printed — and found at once that his central convergence proof was wrong: there were orbits on which an infinitesimal difference in initial conditions grows beyond recognition; he might have blurred the wording, but he chose to reprint the whole edition at his own expense and in the corrected version to lay the error's structure bare, turning the error itself into a discovery — the homoclinic orbit and sensitivity to initial conditions raised the memoir's value rather than lowering it; the price of one error was a fortune in reprinting, and the return was an entire field later called chaos; Poincare proved that the first response to a discovered error decides whether you defend an old name or open a new field — publishing the error's structure is often cheaper than hiding it, and far more valuable

modes.category: 方法论/剥掉度量的本质结构
modes.domain_zh: 他在微分方程定性理论中需要描述'形状的连续变形'——但当时的数学只有度量工具（距离、角度），一变形就失灵；彭加勒干脆把度量全扔掉：只保留连通性、洞的个数、边界关系这些'橡皮膜上不变'的性质——1895 年起发表《位置分析》（Analysis Situs），开创代数拓扑：同调、基本群、贝蒂数——把'图形的本质'定义为一切连续变形下不变的东西；这一'剥掉数字看结构'的透视法后来横扫二十世纪数学，也成了现代物理（规范场论、弦论）的语言；彭加勒证明：要看见本质，先决定什么东西允许改变——不变量的选择就是视角的选择
modes.domain_en: In qualitative theory he needed to describe shape under continuous deformation — but the mathematics of the day had only metrical tools, distance and angle, helpless under any bending; Poincare threw the metrical away outright: keeping only connectivity, the number of holes, boundary relations — what is invariant under the rubber-sheet deformations — founding algebraic topology in Analysis Situs (from 1895): homology, fundamental group, Betti numbers — defining a figure's essence as what survives all continuous deformation; this perspectival stripping of numbers to see structure swept twentieth-century mathematics and became the language of modern physics (gauge theory, string theory); Poincare proved that to see the essence you must first decide what may change — the choice of invariants is the choice of viewpoint
modes.source_chapter: 彭加勒 1895 年发表《位置分析》（Analysis situs），随后五年五篇长篇补充——被视为代数拓扑的奠基文献：他在其中定义了基本群与同调（含三角剖分、对偶胞腔、贝蒂数的积公式），并留下'每个单连通闭三维流形同胚于三维球面'的著名猜想（1900 年第一版叙述有误，1904 年第五篇补充中修正并提出，即彭加勒猜想，2003 年佩雷尔曼证明）；拓扑学的动机直接来自微分方程定性理论：判定极限环的存在与稳定需要绕数（指数）等拓扑不变量；他自称这一学科为'几何学中唯一严格的分支'——因为在任意连续变形下性质不会说谎
modes.key_quote_zh: 把尺子和量角器都收起来——只留下橡皮膜上不变的东西，那才是形状的灵魂
modes.key_quote_en: "Put away ruler and protractor — keep only what survives the rubber sheet; that is the soul of shape."
process_zh: 为问题选'允许变形'的等价类：哪些改变算'同一个东西'（连续变形？重命名？重组？）——等价类的选择就是问题本质的定义
剥掉度量只留结构：距离、角度、坐标都可能干扰——先看连通、环绕、包含这些橡皮膜性质
把结构性质翻译成可计算的代数量：贝蒂数、基本群——'洞的个数'变成数字，直觉获得可验证的形态
用不变量裁决'同与不同'：两个系统的不变量不同，则无论多相似也本质不同——不变量成为最硬的区分证据
process_en: Choose the equivalence class of allowed change: what alterations count as 'the same thing' — continuous deformation, renaming, reorganization; choosing the class defines the problem's essence
Strip the metrical, keep the structural: distance, angle, coordinates may all mislead — first the rubber-sheet properties of connection, winding, containment
Translate structure into computable algebra: Betti numbers, fundamental groups — 'number of holes' becoming number, intuition gaining verifiable form
Decide sameness by invariants: two systems differing in an invariant are essentially different however alike they look — the invariant as the hardest evidence of distinction
representative_cases_zh: 《位置分析》五篇正补（1895-1904）：基本群、同调、对偶剖分——代数拓扑从这一组论文里完整诞生
彭加勒猜想的提出与百年求证（1904 提出，2003 佩雷尔曼证明）：'三维球面的刻画'成为拓扑学的圣杯——不变量思维的最高成就
微分方程定性理论的绕数判据：极限环存在性的拓扑证明——拓扑工具第一次解决分析问题
representative_cases_en: Analysis Situs and its five complements (1895-1904): fundamental group, homology, dual cell subdivisions — algebraic topology born whole from one series
The Poincare conjecture proposed 1904 and proved 2003 by Perelman: the characterization of the three-sphere as topology's holy grail — invariant thinking's supreme achievement
The index criterion in qualitative theory: topological proof of limit cycles' existence — topological tools solving an analytic problem for the first time
modern_applications_zh: 业务诊断先定'允许变形'再比较：组织调整、流程重排后算不算'同一个系统'？先约定等价标准（哪些改变被视为同一）——没有等价类定义，'前后对比'全是噪声
找系统的'贝蒂数'：产品/组织里的独立回路（每个不受其他流程制约的闭环）个数是结构硬指标——回路数变了，系统的本质就变了，无论 KPI 多相似
用不变量识别'换皮'：评估竞品或收购标的时剥掉度量（收入数字、用户数）只看结构（用户关系网络、信息流拓扑）——结构不变量无法粉饰
modern_applications_en: Fix the allowed deformation before comparing: does a reorganization leave 'the same system'? agree first on the equivalence standard — without it, before-after comparisons are noise

Count your system's Betti numbers: the number of independent loops — closed processes unconstrained by others — is a hard structural metric; change the count and the system's essence changes, however similar the KPIs

Spot reskins with invariants: when assessing a competitor or acquisition, strip the metrical (revenue, user counts) and read the structure — the network of relations, the topology of information flow; structural invariants cannot be dressed up

modes.name_en: The Method of Guarding the Principle of Relativity
modes.domain_zh: 迈克尔逊-莫雷实验没测到以太风——大多数人忙着修补以太理论，彭加勒问的是更深一层：是否存在一个任何实验都无法违反的'原理'？他 1904 年在圣路易斯演讲中把'相对性原理'列为物理学的六大普遍原理之一：'对于固定体与匀速运动着的观察者，物理定律必须相同'——并把洛伦兹的数学变换命名为'洛伦兹变换'，指出它正是使一切定律在变换下不变的对称群；1905 年他提交论文证明含引力情形下洛伦兹变换成群，给出四维时空框架与'彭加勒群'；他与爱因斯坦 1905 年各自独立逼近狭义相对论——但彭加勒把它当'物理原理+数学对称'来守护，爱因斯坦把它当'时空本体'来重建；彭加勒证明：当修补方案多如牛毛时，向上抽象一层去找'不可违反的对称性'往往更有生产力
modes.domain_en: The Michelson-Morley experiment found no ether wind; most hurried to patch ether theory — Poincare asked one storey deeper: is there a 'principle' no experiment can violate? In his 1904 St. Louis address he listed the principle of relativity among physics' six universal principles: 'the laws of physics must be the same for a fixed observer and one in uniform motion' — and named Lorentz's mathematical transformation the 'Lorentz transformation,' seeing in it the symmetry group under which all laws must be invariant; in 1905 he proved the transformations form a group including gravitation, supplying the four-dimensional frame and what is now the 'Poincare group'; he and Einstein approached special relativity independently in 1905 — but Poincare guarded it as physical principle plus mathematical symmetry, Einstein rebuilt it as the ontology of spacetime; Poincare proved that when patches multiply, abstracting a storey upward to find the inviolable symmetry is the more productive move
modes.source_chapter: 彭加勒 1895 年起多次讨论'相对运动原理'（相对性原理的早期表述），1904 年 9 月圣路易斯演讲《数学物理的现状与未来》将其列入六大原理（能量守恒、热力学第二定律、牛顿第三定律、相对性原理、质量守恒、最小作用量），并预言'也许我们要建立一种全新的力学，其中惯性随速度增大'；1905 年 6 月提交《论电子的动力学》，独立于爱因斯坦给出洛伦兹变换的群论证明、四维形式与含引力的修正，并提出'光速不可逾越'的论证；他与洛伦兹长期通信，1904-1905 年的工作构成狭义相对论的第二条独立路径；因 1912 年早逝未能参与广义相对论的最终综合——他对爱因斯坦相对论的评论（'原理是事实的约定化'）与自己的约定主义一脉相承
modes.key_quote_zh: 修补以太十次不如守一条原理：一切匀速观察者看到的定律必须相同——剩下的交给数学
modes.key_quote_en: "Ten patches to the ether are not worth one principle: the laws must be the same for all uniform observers — leave the rest to mathematics."
process_zh: 在实验危机中找'不可违反项'：以太实验的-null 结果不是要修补的漏洞，而是指向某个任何理论都必须尊重的约束
把约束升格为'原理'并命为公理：'一切匀速观察者定律相同'——原理一旦确立就不再为个别实验让步
为原理配齐数学结构：变换是否成群？对称是否封闭？——彭加勒补上洛伦兹变换的群论证明与四维形式
让原理产出预言而非只是解释：新力学预言惯性随速度增大、光速为限——原理的产出力是检验其价值的标尺
process_en: In an experimental crisis, seek the inviolable: the null result of the ether experiments was not a leak to patch but a pointer to a constraint any theory must honor
Promote the constraint to a principle and axiomatize it: 'the laws identical for all uniform observers' — once fixed, the principle yields to no single experiment
Fit the principle with mathematical structure: do the transformations form a group? is the symmetry closed? — Poincare supplied the group proof and the four-dimensional form
Make the principle predict, not merely explain: the new mechanics foretold inertia growing with speed and the limit of light — a principle's yield is the measure of its worth
representative_cases_zh: 1904 圣路易斯演讲：把相对性原理列为六大普遍原理并预言'全新力学'——原理性方法的公开宣言
1905《论电子的动力学》：洛伦兹变换群论证明+四维形式+含引力的修正+光速极限论证——与爱因斯坦平行的第二条路径
'彭加勒群'的命名遗产：狭义相对论的完整对称群后世以他命名——数学对称的守护比物理图像的修补更长寿
representative_cases_en: The St. Louis address (1904): relativity listed among six universal principles, 'new mechanics' foretold — the public manifesto of the principle method

On the Dynamics of the Electron (1905): group proof of the Lorentz transformations, the four-dimensional form, the gravitational amendment, the light-speed limit — a second, parallel road to special relativity
The legacy named the Poincare group: the full symmetry group of special relativity bearing his name — guarding mathematical symmetry outlasting patching physical pictures
modern_applications_zh: 危机时刻找'不变式'而非'补丁'：增长失速时不要连续发版打补丁，先问'哪些用户期望无论怎么改版都不能违反'——原理层约定先于方案层修补
把关键约束'公理化'并写进章程：'一切渠道的数据口径必须一致'、'所有端的服务条款同步生效'——原理一旦声明，个别 exception 要走豁免程序
为原理配数学：声明价值观之后要给出可检查的结构（不变量清单、审计脚本）——没有群论证明的相对性原理只是口号
modern_applications_en: In crisis, find the invariant, not the patch: when growth stalls, do not ship patch after patch; ask which user expectations no redesign may violate — principles before patches
Axiomatize key constraints into the charter: 'one data definition across all channels,' 'terms effective on all clients at once' — once declared, exceptions pass through a formal exemption
Give the principle its mathematics: values declared must come with checkable structure — invariant lists, audit scripts; a relativity principle without its group proof is a slogan

modes.name_en: The Method of Weaving Across Domains
modes.category: 方法论/最后一位全才的工作方式
modes.domain_zh: 他被尊为'最后一个精通数学全部分支的人'——但他不是把每门学科各学一遍，而是让学科互相供弹：拓扑工具解决微分方程问题、概率思想进入天体力学、哲学反思反哺科学方法、科学普及写作（他主动为大众写作且写得极好）倒逼概念清晰——他的工作清单横跨自守函数、拓扑、天体力学、概率论、光学、电学、无线报时（曾任经度局成员参与国际时区工作）、数学教育与科学哲学；织物的方式是'结构迁移'：在 A 领域看到的结构（不变量、群、稳定性）被问'B 领域有没有同样的东西'；彭加勒证明：通才不是广度的堆积，而是一套可以在任何领域复用的'深层语法'
modes.domain_en: He was honored as 'the last man to master all of mathematics' — not by learning each field in turn, but by letting fields supply one another's ammunition: topological tools on differential equations, probabilistic thought in celestial mechanics, philosophical reflection feeding method, popular writing (which he undertook and excelled at) forcing conceptual clarity; his works span automorphic functions, topology, celestial mechanics, probability, optics, electricity, wireless time-keeping (a Bureau des Longitudes member in the international time-zone work), mathematical education, philosophy of science; the weave was 'structural transfer': a structure seen in field A — invariant, group, stability — was asked whether field B held its like; Poincare proved that universality is not a pile of breadth but a deep grammar reusable in any field
modes.source_chapter: 彭加勒（1854-1912）一生发表约 500 篇论文与 30 余部著作：数学（自守函数、代数拓扑、代数几何、数论）、物理（天体力学三卷《天体力学新方法》、光学、电磁学、狭义相对论路径、量子论的早期评论）、应用（经度局成员、参与国际时间与经度标准化、无线报时专利与爱迪生-特斯拉时代的电报同步问题、为法国矿业部做矿业调查）、哲学与科普（《科学与假设》《科学与方法》《科学的价值》风行各国）；他任巴黎大学（索邦）理学院教授，讲坛覆盖几乎全部数理学科；'最后一位全才'之说通行于科学史——其跨域的实质不是知识面宽，而是把'结构'当通用货币在不同学科间兑换
modes.key_quote_zh: 我不是样样都懂——我是把一种结构在任何地方都认得出来
modes.key_quote_en: "It is not that I know everything — it is that I recognize one structure wherever it appears."
process_zh: 把领域知识压缩成'结构'再存储：学一个领域时不记条目而记结构（什么量不变？什么过程可逆？什么变换成群？）——结构才可跨域搬运
主动做'结构迁移'的问询：每学一个新领域的概念就问'这与我已知的哪个结构同构'——映射表越用越厚
以输出压力维持跨域纪律：为大众写作《科学与假设》级别的科普——讲不清就是没压缩好，被迫把结构提到语言表层
接受跨域的制度性职务：经度局、矿业调查、时区工作——实务职务把抽象结构压进真实约束，防止通才漂向空谈
process_en: Compress domain knowledge into structure for storage: learn a field not as entries but as structure — what is invariant, what reversible, what forms a group; only structure ships across domains
Query by structural transfer: at each new concept ask which known structure it is isomorphic to — the mapping table thickens with use

Keep output pressure for cross-domain discipline: write popularization at the level of Science and Hypothesis — what cannot be explained was not compressed; structure forced to the surface of language

Take institutional duties that cross over: the Bureau des Longitudes, mining surveys, time-zone work — practical offices pressing abstract structure against real constraints, keeping the generalist from drifting into talk
representative_cases_zh: 三卷《天体力学新方法》（1892-1899）：把拓扑与定性方法带进天体力学——一个领域的工具改写另一个领域的教科书
经度局与国际时区工作：抽象的对称与同步知识被用于真实的世界时间标准化——结构迁移的实务样本
《科学与假设》成为世纪畅销书：跨域通才以大众语言自我训练——科普不是副业而是压缩检验
representative_cases_en: New Methods of Celestial Mechanics, three volumes (1892-99): topological and qualitative tools carried into celestial mechanics — one field's instruments rewriting another's textbook
The Bureau des Longitudes and international time: abstract symmetry and synchronization applied to real standardization of world time — structural transfer in practice
Science and Hypothesis as an international bestseller: the generalist training himself in plain language — popularization as compression test, not side line
modern_applications_zh: 跨行求职/转岗时以'结构语法'而非'技能清单'自述：不罗列工具，而讲清'我在 A 领域掌握的不变量/反馈/分叉结构如何映射到 B'——通才的正确卖法是语法不是词表
每季度做一次'结构迁移问询'：把本行业最近一个热点概念与另一学科的同构物配对（如'混沌'配'舆情'、'拓扑'配'组织'）——配对笔记是跨域复用的原材料
以科普倒逼压缩：把你的专业写成外行能读的一页——写不出的部分就是你尚未掌握结构的部分
modern_applications_en: Sell breadth as grammar, not vocabulary: in changing fields, list no tools; show how the invariants, feedback and bifurcation structures mastered in A map onto B

A quarterly structural-transfer query: pair each hot concept of your field with an isomorph from another — 'chaos' with public opinion, 'topology' with organization; the pairing notes are the raw stock of reuse
Let popularization force compression: write your specialty as one page a layman can read — what you cannot write is the structure you do not yet hold
modes.definition_zh: 他被尊为'最后一个精通数学全部分支的人'——但他不是把每门学科各学一遍，而是让学科互相供弹：拓扑工具解决微分方程问题、概率思想进入天体力学、哲学反思反哺科学方法、科学普及写作（他主动为大众写作且写得极好）倒逼概念清晰——他的工作清单横跨自守函数、拓扑、天体力学、概率论、光学、电学、无线报时（曾任经度局成员参与国际时区工作）、数学教育与科学哲学；织物的方式是'结构迁移'：在 A 领域看到的结构（不变量、群、稳定性）被问'B 领域有没有同样的东西'；彭加勒证明：通才不是广度的堆积，而是一套可以在任何领域复用的'深层语法'
modes.definition_en: He was honored as 'the last man to master all of mathematics' — not by learning each field in turn, but by letting fields supply one another's ammunition: topological tools on differential equations, probabilistic thought in celestial mechanics, philosophical reflection feeding method, popular writing (which he undertook and excelled at) forcing conceptual clarity; his works span automorphic functions, topology, celestial mechanics, probability, optics, electricity, wireless time-keeping (a Bureau des Longitudes member in the international time-zone work), mathematical education, philosophy of science; the weave was 'structural transfer': a structure seen in field A — invariant, group, stability — was asked whether field B held its like; Poincare proved that universality is not a pile of breadth but a deep grammar reusable in any field

modes.name_en: The Method of Layering Science and Hypothesis
modes.category: 科学哲学/假设的解剖学
modes.domain_zh: 他在《科学与假设》里做的事是给科学的全部'信念'做一次分层手术：哪些是实验直接给出的事实，哪些是概括事实的定律，哪些是数学定义，哪些是约定（几何、度量衡），哪些是没被意识到的形而上学预设（如'自然简单'、'遥远原因无影响'）——普通科学家把这一切搅成一碗粥，然后争论'科学是否客观'；彭加勒的分层使每一层接受不同的检验：事实受观测检验、定律受归纳检验、约定只受方便性检验、预设要被点名并接受批判——科学不是一堆同样坚固的真理，而是一座各层建材不同的塔；他由此给出科学辩护的新范式：科学的可信性不来自每一条都'真'，而来自分层清楚、各层检验得当；彭加勒证明：对科学的最强辩护不是宣布它无懈可击，而是精确说明它哪里可能错、哪里无所谓对错
modes.domain_en: In Science and Hypothesis he performed a stratifying surgery on all of science's beliefs: which are facts given by experiment, which laws generalizing facts, which mathematical definitions, which conventions (geometry, measures), which unconscious metaphysical presuppositions (that nature is simple, that distant causes have no effect); the ordinary scientist stirs all into one gruel and quarrels whether 'science is objective'; Poincare's layering gives each layer its own test: facts by observation, laws by induction, conventions by convenience alone, presuppositions named and criticized — science is not a mass of equally solid truths but a tower of different building materials; and so a new defense of science: its credibility lies not in every line being true but in the layers being distinct and each tested as it should be; Poincare proved that the strongest defense of science is not to declare it unassailable but to say precisely where it may err and where error is meaningless
modes.source_chapter: 《科学与假设》（1902）汇编彭加勒 1890 年代论几何学、力学、假设的论文，序言经庞加莱自己重写为通俗版；全书结构即分层：数学与逻辑（数的定义、量与测量）、空间（几何学的约定性）、力（力学原理的约定性、绝对运动之辩）、自然界（假设的两类：'中性假设'与'真正的假设'，假设在科学中的角色）；他区分'抛弃一个假设'与'抛弃整座建筑'的成本结构，主张'概括（推广）是科学家的正当野心，但每一步概括都是新假设需单独点名'——本书对逻辑实证主义（维也纳学派）与爱因斯坦均产生直接影响，是科学哲学史的分水岭文本
modes.key_quote_zh: 科学的塔不是一种建材盖的——先弄清哪层是事实、哪层是定律、哪层只是约定，争论才有靶子
modes.key_quote_en: "Science's tower is not one material — know which storey is fact, which law, which mere convention, and disputes find targets at last."
process_zh: 把一整套'我们相信的'列成清单并逐条定性：这条是观测事实、经验定律、定义、约定还是未被点名的预设？——先分类后争论
为每层配备专属检验：事实对观测、定律对归纳、约定对方便、预设对批判——用错检验是科学争论最常见的浪费
点名'中性假设'：写论文/方案时把'为计算方便而引入、不打算赋予物理意义'的假设单列——中性假设不许悄悄变成结论
以分层重组辩护：被质疑时先回答'你质疑的是哪一层'——层的错不连坐全塔，约定的错只需换约定
process_en: List the whole 'what we believe' and classify each item: observed fact, empirical law, definition, convention, or unnamed presupposition — classify first, argue after
Fit each layer with its own test: facts to observation, laws to induction, conventions to convenience, presuppositions to critique; misapplied tests are the commonest waste in scientific quarrels

Name the neutral assumptions: in any paper or proposal, list separately the assumptions introduced for computational convenience and meant to carry no physical weight — neutral assumptions must not quietly become conclusions
Defend by layering: when challenged, first answer 'which layer do you question' — an error in one storey does not condemn the tower; a wrong convention needs only a new convention
representative_cases_zh: 《科学与假设》(1902) 全书结构：数学-空间-力-自然四部，逐层解剖科学的信念构成——科学哲学的分水岭文本
几何学的约定豁免：把'三角形内角和'从实验裁决名单上移出——分层手术最著名的案例
对'自然简单性'预设的点名：他明确指出'简单性'是我们强加给自然的赌注而非观察所得——未被意识的最大假设被拉到台前
representative_cases_en: The architecture of Science and Hypothesis (1902): four parts — number, space, force, nature — dissecting science's beliefs storey by storey; a watershed in philosophy of science
The conventional exemption of geometry: the triangle's angles struck from the list of what experiment may decide — the stratifying surgery's most famous case
Naming the presupposition of simplicity: 'simplicity' as our wager on nature, not something observed — the largest unconscious assumption dragged on stage
modern_applications_zh: 给任何'体系论证'做分层审计：读白皮书、商业计划、方法论手册时，把每一条主张标注为事实/定律/定义/约定/预设——被包装成事实的约定（'行业最佳实践'）立即现形
写方案时自带'假设清单页'：明确列出哪些是数据、哪些是外推、哪些是为计算方便的中性假设——与彭加勒的论文伦理一致，也与道尔顿'标注假设'一脉相通
争论先分层再开火：团队争'这个指标对不对'时先问'我们争的是定义（约定）、口径（事实）还是用法（预设）'——三层混战是最常见的会议浪费
modern_applications_en: Audit any system argument by layer: in white papers, business plans, method handbooks, tag every claim as fact, law, definition, convention or presupposition — conventions dressed as facts ('industry best practice') stand revealed at once
Ship proposals with an assumptions page: which lines are data, which extrapolation, which neutral assumptions of convenience — Poincare's ethics of the memoir, kin to Dalton's labeled assumptions

Layer the dispute before firing: when the team argues whether a metric is right, ask whether the quarrel is definition (convention), measurement (fact) or use (presupposition) — three-layer mêlées are the commonest waste of meetings

modes.name_en: The Method of Duty and Delight as Twin Salaries
modes.category: 个人品格/责任与欢愉的同体
modes.domain_zh: 他一生身兼数职：索邦教授（讲坛覆盖几乎全部数理学科）、经度局成员、矿业工程师出身（后任矿业团总工程师）、法国科学院多院院士（科学、政治道德学院）——每个职务都是重负；但他同时给大众写作、给女儿们朗读、参与德雷福斯案的科学与正义讨论；支撑这一切的不是苦役式的纪律，而是他把'义务'与'热爱'设计成双薪制：职务的义务部分供给研究与写作的素材与约束（矿业调查给他的应用数学、经度局给他的时间同步问题），热爱部分（数学之美、给普通人讲清的快感）供给续航——他不把义务当热爱之敌，而是当热爱的工作条件；临终前数周他仍在写关于伦理与科学的讲稿（'科学即规则'）；彭加勒证明：热情不靠意志力维持，靠结构维持——当义务喂给热爱原料、热爱给义务供能时，一个人才可能同时做多件事而不崩溃
modes.domain_en: All his life he held several posts at once: Sorbonne professor (lecturing across nearly all the mathematical sciences), member of the Bureau des Longitudes, mining engineer by training (later chief engineer of the mining corps), member of several academies (sciences; and of the moral and political sciences) — each post a burden; yet he wrote for the public, read to his daughters, joined the scientific and moral discussion of the Dreyfus affair; what sustained this was not discipline as drudgery but his design of duty and delight as twin salaries: the obligatory side of his offices supplied material and constraint for research and writing (mining surveys feeding applied mathematics, the Bureau feeding the synchronization of time), the beloved side (the beauty of mathematics, the pleasure of explaining to ordinary readers) supplied endurance — he did not set duty against delight but made it delight's working condition; weeks before his death he was still writing lectures on ethics and science ('science as rule'); Poincare proved that passion is maintained not by willpower but by structure — when duty feeds delight its raw material and delight powers duty, one person can do many things at once without collapsing
modes.source_chapter: 彭加勒 1879 年矿业团工程师出身（里尔矿业学院任教前曾任矿业调查），1881 年入巴黎大学（索邦）理学院任教授直至 1912 年去世，讲坛先后覆盖分析与天体力学、概率论、电学与光学、数学物理——他每年更换讲题以保持全才；1885 年起任经度局成员，参与国际时间与经度标准（世界时区体系 1884 年确立后的技术工作）；1908 年入选法兰西学术院（Académie française，文学与语言至高机构）——科学家入选极罕见；1908 年当选后不久被诊断前列腺肥大手术，1912 年 7 月术后血栓去世（58 岁）；临终前写作伦理与科学讲稿（《道德与科学》《科学与方法》末章）；家庭：与 Louise Poulain d'Andecy 成婚，育有一子三女——'义务与热爱双薪'的工作结构使其在多重职务下保持高产 33 年
modes.key_quote_zh: 义务供给原料，热爱供给续航——两份薪水一起领，一件差事都不苦
modes.key_quote_en: "Duty supplies the material, delight the endurance — draw both salaries, and no task is drudgery."
process_zh: 为每份义务找'热爱接口'：接受任何职务前先回答'这份差事能给我的研究/写作供什么料'——矿业调查供了应用数学，经度局供了时间同步
为每份热爱找'义务出口'：给大众写作、讲课、回应公众问题——热爱只有变成对他人的义务才获得持续性与重量
用年更讲题保持全才续航：索邦讲坛每年换题目——以结构化轮换防止通才的单域僵化
临终仍在产出'规则性'工作：生命的最后几周写伦理与科学讲稿——热爱与义务的双薪发到最后一周
process_en: Find the delight-interface of every duty: before accepting any office answer what it feeds your research or writing — mining surveys fed applied mathematics, the Bureau fed the synchronization of time
Give every delight a dutiful outlet: writing for the public, lecturing, answering lay questions — delight gains duration and weight only as an obligation to others
Rotate the lectern yearly for endurance: a new topic each year at the Sorbonne — structured rotation keeping the generalist from hardening in one field
Keep producing 'rule-like' work to the last weeks: lectures on ethics and science in his dying weeks — both salaries drawn until the final one
representative_cases_zh: 索邦三十三年与年更讲题（1881-1912）：讲坛轮换覆盖全部数理学科——多重职务下的持续高产样板
经度局与国际时区工作：把最抽象的对称知识交给最实际的世界时钟——义务喂热爱原料的典型接口
法兰西学术院入选（1908）与临终伦理讲稿：科学家被文学至高机构接纳、至死在写'科学即规则'——热爱与义务的最后合流
representative_cases_en: Thirty-three years at the Sorbonne, topic renewed yearly (1881-1912): the lectern rotating across all the mathematical sciences — sustained output under many offices
The Bureau des Longitudes and world time: the most abstract knowledge of symmetry given to the most actual of world clocks — the model interface of duty feeding delight
The Académie française (1908) and the dying weeks' ethics lectures: a scientist received by the highest seat of letters, writing 'science as rule' to the end — delight and duty's last confluence
modern_applications_zh: 接副业/兼差前做'双薪审计'：这份差事的义务部分给我供什么料（数据、案例、约束）？我的热爱部分能给差事供什么能（热情、清晰）？——两边都答不上来的活不接
把'给普通人讲清'设为义务：定期公开分享、写作、答疑——热爱只有变成对他人的义务才能持续多年
以年更为单位轮换主题：工作内容每年注入一个新领域/新题目——结构化轮换防止全才在单一领域僵化，也防止多线程者被旧任务淹没
modern_applications_en: Audit side engagements for twin salaries: what does the obligatory side feed you (data, cases, constraints), what can the beloved side feed it (energy, clarity)? — take no work that answers neither
Make 'explaining to laymen' a duty: regular public sharing, writing, answering — delight endures the years only as an obligation to others
Rotate themes yearly: inject one new field or question into the work's content each year — structured rotation keeping the generalist limber and the multi-threaded from drowning in the old
